categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, owner identities, and property classifications. The content is focused entirely on land and property-related administrative matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4).
